:::{#def-momentum-coefficient}
#### Momentum coefficient

Let $\vg^{(0)}, \vg^{(1)}, \ldots$ be vectors in $\reals^p$,
and let $\vv^{(t)}$ be a running velocity built from them.
The **momentum coefficient** $\beta \in [0, 1)$ is the weight on the previous velocity in

$$
\vv^{(t)} \eqdef \beta\,\vv^{(t-1)} + \vg^{(t)},
$$

with $\vv^{(-1)} \eqdef \vzero$.

:::
